standing: Leads the AFC East by 3.5 games

lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.h: Tre'Davious White and Shaq Thompson elevated
news.b: With CB Christian Benford and LB Dorian Williams ruled out, the Bills elevated CB Tre'Davious White and LB Shaq Thompson from the practice squad Saturday. It's the first elevation this season for both former first-round picks. Maxwell Hairston and rookie Kaleb Elarms-Orr are expected to start in their places, with White and Thompson in rotational roles.

news.h: Fourth straight backup QB for Buffalo's defense
news.b: Miami's Kyle McCord makes his second NFL start, the fourth straight game the Bills face a backup. He went 17-of-32 for 209 yards in a 24-22 loss at Indianapolis. Over the last three games, Buffalo has allowed 28 total points, opponents are 17.6% on third down, and the defense has eight takeaways.

news.h: Dolphins activate Baker; Carlson and Browning elevated
news.b: Miami activated CB Darrell Baker Jr. from PUP on Saturday, and he is expected to debut at Buffalo. The Dolphins also elevated K Daniel Carlson and P Jack Browning for the game. RB Devon Achane and QB Malik Willis are unavailable, so Ollie Gordon leads the run game and McCord starts.

news.h: Win would push the division lead to 4.5 games
news.b: New England (5-5) is on its bye after a 35-10 loss to Detroit, and the Jets (2-8) play at the Chargers at 4:05 p.m. A Bills win over Miami today would put Buffalo 4.5 games up in the AFC East before Thursday's Thanksgiving-night game against Kansas City.

source: buffalobills.com Week 11 storylines (Nov 18); SI and Heavy on Bills elevations (Nov 21); Yahoo/SI on Dolphins moves (Nov 21); ESPN standings and schedule (checked Nov 22, no AFC East games since Nov 20).
